hypothesis: Active faulting localises where geodetic strain and seismicity concentrate, and its surface expression is a coherent topographic ridge. Combining the two selects blind fault traces that scarp-dependent USGS/INGENIOUS mapping missed — without ever consulting the mapped catalogue to decide where to place a positive.
mechanism: prior = z(geod_2ndinv, geod_shearrate, ieq_n100a10) + 0.5 * z(structure_tensor_ridge of the LiDAR scarp stack). Greedy blue-noise sample of the prior with a 3-cell (300 m) minimum separation, 1-cell emission, and a hard 4-cell (400 m) collar around the COMPLETE official USGS/INGENIOUS fault database (156,418 cells), inside the official NaN footprint.
named_non_fault_process: Alluvial-fan toes and terrace risers produce coherent slope-excess ridges indistinguishable in the DEM from fault scarps, and intraplate strain concentrates along basin axes without surface rupture. The 400 m catalogue collar removes the mapped mimics; the 300 m separation and single-cell emission bound the unmapped ones. This is not fully removed.

holdout_dti.label: HOLDOUT-DTI
holdout_dti.protocol: 144 spatial blocks; whole fault features withheld by block (20% of blocks); collar mask rebuilt from visible features only; single-feature AUC canary
holdout_dti.critical_caveat: The holdout truth is MAPPED fault traces. The leaderboard truth is UNMAPPED faults, and the nine-site evidence shows leaderboard score is anti-correlated with catalogue fidelity (Spearman -1.000). The 3.14x ratio therefore measures placement quality against the wrong population for scoring purposes and is NOT converted into a score.

correlation_overlap_vs_registry.scope_note: Compared against the nine hash-pinned focus-site champions plus every local download. The wider GEMSDOE corpus (~90 sites) is not mirrored locally.

against_calibration_lattice.interpretation: The r13 lattice is a space-filling calibration probe, not a competing submission. At this dot count any interior placement exceeds 70 % by pigeonhole: a seeded random control at the identical count scores 99.91 %, i.e. WORSE than this candidate. The literal test is non-discriminating (IR-S-01, IR-RV-04) and is disclosed, not hidden.

score_evidence.label: MODEL ESTIMATE — NOT organizer-confirmed
score_evidence.method: controlled extrapolation at fixed dot budget (see controlled_comparison)
what_is_not_claimed: The 3.14x holdout advantage is not converted into score.

controlled_comparison.why: The candidate deliberately carries the champion's exact dot count so that the only variable that changes is catalogue contamination. This makes the comparison a controlled experiment rather than a projection.
controlled_comparison.anchor: GEMSDOE32 h33-h33-2-b2, 37,654 dots, 5.77 % within 3 px of the bridge catalogue, reported 0.2778

design_validation.verdict: the pre-registered 3 px minimum separation is confirmed optimal; 5 px loses 17 % of holdout DTI

prior_independence.verdict: the prior is NOT a catalogue proxy; it is a genuinely independent field
prior_independence.note: a weak relationship is expected and desirable — the design needs faults near active structure but not on already-mapped traces

limitations: No organizer receipt exists for any file in this repository; every leaderboard value in the brief is USER-REPORTED and unverified.
A weekly slot is the owner's decision, taken on the DrivenData submission page; this receipt does not reserve or spend one.
The 0.29 figure is a model estimate from a controlled one-variable extrapolation. It is not an organizer score and must never be written as one.
The expected gain over the incumbent 0.2778 is roughly +0.008. It is the best-supported move available, not a large one.

The literal 70 %-within-3-px rule is FAILED against the r13 calibration lattice (99.37 %), exactly as it is failed by a seeded random placement at the same dot count (99.91 %). The rule is saturated and discriminates nothing at this budget; the owner must rule whether the probe is exempt (IR-S-01/IR-RV-04).
superseded_reason: On a fault compilation the model never saw, this file scores DTI 0.207-0.244 versus 0.295 for a same-size space-filling lattice and 0.403 for the band-19 density that replaced it (evidence/emission_controls.json). Its advantage was measured against the catalogue, which is also its training label.
